name: lsp
description:
Interacts with the Dart Language Server Protocol (LSP) to provide code intelligence features like hover, signature help, and symbol resolution.
Commands:
- hover: Get hover information (docs, types) at a position. Requires: uri, line, column.
- signatureHelp: Get signature help at a position. Requires: uri, line, column.
- resolveWorkspaceSymbol: Fuzzy search for symbols by name. Requires: query.

column.description: The zero-based column number. Required for "hover" and "signatureHelp".

line.description: The zero-based line number. Required for "hover" and "signatureHelp".

uri.description: The URI of the file. Required for "hover" and "signatureHelp".
